◈ FLASHBACK — Carpenter's square
Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now.
💛 The Carpenter's square is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

◈ FLASHBACK — Search locket
The last photo, the one where they're laughing at something off-camera. You'll ask the System what it wants, later. First: them.
💛 The Search locket is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)

◈ FLASHBACK — Boot stone
You carry a guilt like a stone in the boot. So you carry a stone in the boot — the scattering took the one person you were keeping alive, and this is the shape of that. It keeps you honest.
💛 The Boot stone is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.
💛 The Trail compass is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
